For \(n\le 17\), \(S_n\le 1^2+\cdots+17^2=1785<2016\), so impossible.

For \(n=18\),
\[
S_{18}=\frac{18\cdot 19\cdot 37}{6}=2109
\]
is odd, so \(M,N\) cannot be integers.

For \(n=19\),
\[
S_{19}=2109+19^2=2470
\]
is even. We need a subset \(B\) with square-sum
\[
T=\frac{S_{19}+2016}{2}=\frac{2470+2016}{2}=2243.
\]
Equivalently, its complement \(C\) must have square-sum
\[
2470-2243=227.
\]
Since
\[
227=13^2+7^2+3^2=169+49+9,
\]
such a partition exists.

Thus the smallest possible value is

\[
\boxed{19}
\]
